Festive vibes, complete sightseeing of major attractions without the scorching heat of summer. Enjoy street food.
Enjoy amazing sightseeing in Delhi, and beware of smog. Carry woolen clothes and warm layers.

blocks.text: The cost of our Delhi Local Sightseeing Tour is just INR 3,500 . And if you 3ant to club this tour with other nearby attractions, such as Agra, Haridwar, Nainital, or Jaipur, then the cost will go up to INR 7,000. Check out our various trip packages and see what suits you best!
In our tour plan, we include meals, hotels, and dedicated transport with a professional driver. Come and join in this unique adventure that you’ve never been on before!
Top Places to Visit on Delhi Sightseeing Tour
To taste the real Delhi, add the following places to your Delhi Travel Packages itinerary and thank us later!

Humayun's tomb is a clear manifestation of the eternal love between Mughal emperor Humayun and his first wife, Empress Haji Begum. The mausoleum guards the graves of both rulers. It's popular for its magical appearance and beautiful natural surroundings.

The Qutub Minar is a 73-foot-tall monument that has been here almost as long as the history of the Delhi Sultanate. It is proudly referenced as the world's tallest brick minaret by the UNESCO World Heritage Site.

This Mughal architectural masterpiece has red sandstone walls, where Shah Jahan resided. It showcases a subtle blend of Islamic, Hindu, Persian, and Timurid design features. Must be included in any Delhi Tourism Package!

Check into New Delhi's Air Force Museum to understand the story of the Indian Air Force. Interactive memorials, photos, and artifacts presented in different ways allow visitors a memorable experience.
Delhi's National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy house unique artifacts featuring traditional crafts such as textiles and clay figures.

Founded in 1949, the institute boasts an expansive repository of artefacts that date as far back as ancient civilizations. From manuscripts to numismatics, jewellery to textiles, you can find every form of historic creation here.

The National Science Centre, named "Dream Castle for One and All," is one of the largest science centers in Asia. Spreading from 8 floors, it displays interactive science exhibits including the Heritage & Dinosaur Gallery and Human Biology Gallery.
Paranthe wali Gali, Kuremal Mohan Lal Kulfi Wale, Khan Omelette Corner, etc.
Nazim's Kathi Roll, Mutton Curry at Kake Da Hotel, Jain Chawal Wale, etc. A perfect addition for a weekend tour packages from Delhi!

Sikh spirituality is epitomized by Gurudwara Bangla Sahib, which is distinguished by its peaceful and uninterrupted (24/7) prayer services. The quiet pond makes it look even more appealing, so this place should be visited, especially at night.

To feel the energy of old and new coexisting, visit Hauz Khas Village, which has a vibrant nightlife and historic reservoirs. The area has many pubs, clubs, and restaurants. A must-visit on your 1 day Delhi tour.
A popular morning walking spot, Deer Park consists of Picnic Huts and is located close to Hauz Khas village.
The garden is particularly well known for its green features, artwork placements, and statues, immersing its visitors in a sensuous experience.
It has large meadows, plenty of flower beds, and wooded grounds that bring people here for walks, picnics, and to take a break.

items: Always have a water bottle with you to avoid waterborne diseases.
While visiting any religious institutions, make sure you wear modest clothes.
Book your Delhi City Tour in advance.
If you're going on a Delhi tour in the summer, then wear cotton clothes.
To protect yourself from pollution, wear N-95 or N-99 masks.
Be wary of pickpockets, especially in crowded markets and other areas.

Ans. Yes, if you prefer a less crowded holiday. However, it is generally recommended to plan your holiday in Goa during the winter season as the weather is more pleasant.

Q5. Do the Goan churches open up daily?
Ans. Yes, most churches, including the Basilica of Bom Jesus, open daily. However, hours may differ, and temples are more crowded on Sundays and festivals.
Q6. What are some must-try street food items?
Ans. You should try Goan snacks like Ros Omelette, Cutlet Pav, and Choris Pao to enjoy the local flavor.
Q7. Does the package include Ayurvedic therapy?
Ans. No, Ayurvedic therapy is not included in the package and requires additional payment. Our travel representative can help you select the best and legitimate centers in the area.

blocks.text: Take a trip to one of India's holiest cities, that is Ujjain. Revered as one of the Sapta Puris, the sacred place offers you rich culture, brilliant temples, and delicious cuisine. Book our Ujjain Tour Package from Ahmedabad and enjoy a seamless pilgrimage here. Really, the city has a lot of things to offer. From Bhasma Aarti to serene Ghats to myriads of beautiful shrines, the place would leave a forever mark on your mind and soul. Call us now to visit the heart of India!

In this tour plan, we'll handle all the tour logistics for you. Whether it's the hotel booking, meal planning, or assigning a dedicated vehicle to you with an experienced driver -- we'll handle everything so that you can enjoy your pilgrimage with a free mind. Book your Ujjain Omkareshwar Maheshwar Tour today!
How to Reach Ujjain from Ahmedabad?
There are a variety of ways via which you can reach Ujjain from Ahmedabad:

items: By Train : Railways are such a good way to cover the tour between the two cities, as there are direct trains available which you can book easily at the IRCTC website. Get on the Ahmedabad Junction and deboard at Ujjain Junction. The entire journey will take you about 8 to 9 hours.
By Road : Simply get on the NH 47. You can also hire a private taxi or take a bus to get here. Many luxury buses also run on this 400 km route.
By Air : The nearest airport to Ujjain is in Indore, which is located about 55 km away. The good thing is that there are direct flights available from Ahmedabad.

blocks.text: Tour Highlights of Ujjain Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan Package
Here are some quality experiences that you're going to get with this holy trip:

items: Enjoy a comfortable Darshan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga
Attend the one-of-a-kind Bhasma Aarti at the shrine
Scared visits to the temples like Harsiddhi Mata Temple, Bade Ganesh Mandir, ISKCON Temple, and Chintaman Ganesh Temple
Enjoy the evening Aarti at the Ram Ghat. Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere at the banks of the river Kshipra
Exploration of the Kajal Rani Caves
Discover the rich culture of Indore
All meals will be provided (100% vegetarian)
Enjoy a trip to the Omkareshwara temple, which is yet another sacred Jyotirlinga

The respective distances are as follows:
The route is quite scenic and you'll find plenty of Dhabas and fuel stations along the way!
Here's how a typical Ujjain tour looks like:
Welcome to the holy city of Ujjain! You'll be taken on a sightseeing tour to the Ram Ghat. Attend the mesmerizing evening Aarti here.
Get up early and attend the Bhasma Aarti at Mahakaleshwar Temple. Later on, you'll be taken for a temple tour of Harsiddhi Temple, Bade Ganeshji Ka Mandir, Kal Bhairav Temple, and ISKCON Temple.
Explore the local dishes here, which have a reputation for being delicious!
Day 3: Ujjain Omkareshwar Tour and Departure
Enjoy hearty breakfast and then get ready for the Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga trip. Afterwards, head back towards Ahmedabad.
The best time to visit Ujjain is from October to March. The weather is delightful and has a wintery charm, making it perfectly suitable for you to come here.
You can also come here in the summer months, but be wary of the hot weather. The temperature can easily cross 35 degrees Celsius during the daytime.
Try coming here in the months of February/March when the holy festival of Maha Shivratri is celebrated. The grandeur is noteworthy, especially in the Mahakaleshwar temple.
Cost of Ujjain Travel Package from Ahmedabad

The cost of our Ujjain packages varies based on the trip type. Our budget Ujjain trip from Ahmedabad is of INR 6,500 . You can also combine your trip with the other Jyotirlingas and go on an Ujjain Omkareshwar Tour , which has a price of INR 27,500.
In these plans, your meals, accommodation, and transportation are fully taken care of by us!
Why Book the Ujjain Tour with My Quick Trippers?

We have been a leader in the travel industry for years now and have conducted a great many tours, especially pilgrimages. With our services, you get to enjoy top accommodation, timely meals, and dedicated transport. Whether you are a solo traveller or want the best Ujjain trip package from Ahmedabad for family, we provide it all! Call us now to go on a memorable trip of your life!
Q1. In which month is Mahakaleshwar less crowded?

Ans. Mahakaleshwar Temple is the least crowded in the months between October and February. It's most crowded in the Shravan month. It also sees a lot of pilgrim traffic on festivals and even Mondays. So, if you're looking for a peaceful Darshan, then avoid these days.
Q2. How to get VIP Darshan in Mahakal?
Ans. You can get VIP Darshan either via online (visit the shrimahakaleshwar.com) or offline (simply go to the temple's ticket counter). The cost of a VIP Pass per person is INR 250.
Q3. Can I attend Bhasma Aarti without booking?

Ans. No, you must book online before going for the Bhasma Aarti. This has been done as there's a huge demand for this special Aarti. You can book online by vesting the official Mahakaleshwar website. Try to book at least 30 days before the actual trip.
Q4. How much time is required for Ujjain Darshan?

Ans. On weekdays, when there's less crowd, it'll take you about 1–2 hours. However, on special occasions like festivals, Shravan month, or even Mondays, the crowd is large, and it might consume 3 to 5 hours in Darshan and Poojan.
Q5. Should we visit Omkareshwar or Mahakaleshwar first?

Ans. Religiously, there's no rule on which Jyotirlinga to visit first. But logistics-wise, you should visit the Mahakaleshwar Temple first, and then cover the Omkareshwar tour. This is also a popular path taken by most pilgrims as Ujjain offers you good transport connectivity. Simply take a taxi or bus for the Omkareshwar tour!

acceptedAnswer.text: Even though there is no harm mentioned in drinking tap water, not many people, including locals, drink it. Bottled is the preferred and safer option.

mainEntity.name: Can Monsoons In Thailand Be Bad?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a natural season cycle, Thailand also has monsoons. They might not particularly be devastating, but they can easily dampen travel plans of any tourist due to unpredictable rains.

mainEntity.name: Where Can One Go For Snorkeling In Thailand?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ao Mae Yai Bay, Koh Nang Yuan, Aow Leuk, Maya Bay, and Ao Niang Bay are some of the best to go for snorkeling in Thailand.

mainEntity.name: Which Months Are Considered Best To Visit Phuket?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cool and dry season is considered as the best time to visit Phuket, i.e., during the months of November and March. One can experience pleasant temperatures and no downpours which are best for traveling.

blocks.text: We offer well curated tour packages to Ayodhya from Delhi that connect you spiritually with the divine. Experience the pure and pious vibes as you walk through the streets of Ayodhya to every sacred temple that holds massive religious as well as historical significance. Immerse yourself in the “Nagri of Shri Ram” (the city of Shri Ram), leaving all the worries behind.

Ayodhya, located in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is one of the most sacred cities in India associated with the epic Ramayana. According to Hindu mythology, Ayodhya is the birth place of Lord Ram and is also associated with Buddha. Thousands of pilgrims visit the temples in Ayodhya to seek blessings and offer their prayers to Lord Sri Ram. Sri Ram is the seventh incarnation of Lord Vishnu as per Hindu Granths or scriptures. Ayodhya is one among the Sapta Puri (seven sacred cities) along with Varanasi (Kashi), Haridwar, Mathura, Ujjain, Dwarka and Kanchipuram.

Besides its religious significance, it also has a rich and complex history. The sacred city of Ayodhya has been in the news due to the Babri Masjid and Ram Mandir dispute for years which has been a key topic for both religious and political debates. Today, Ram Mandir welcomes devotees with open arms which is believed to be built at the same place where Lord Sri Ram was born, and hence also known as Ram Janambhumi.

The other key attractions to visit in Ayodhya are Hanuman Garhi dedicated to Lord Sri Ram’s dearest devotee Lord Hanuman, Kanak Bhawan, dedicated to Sri Ram and Goddess Sita; and Treta ke Thakur Temple which is believed to be the place where Sri Ram performed Ashwamedha Yajna.

Best Time to Visit Varanasi from Ahmedabad

The best time to visit Varanasi is in the winter (October-March) when the weather is cool and pleasant. This gives you ample opportunity to explore the city in peace. The temperature ranges from 7°C to 28°C. You can easily go for the Ganga Aarti, boat rides, temple tours, and even enjoy a full-fledged city tour.

Also, we advise against booking your Varanasi holiday packages in the summer and monsoon season, as they make your sightseeing difficult because of the hot and humid weather. However, a plus point for these seasons is that it's relatively less crowded and you also get to avail hotel discounts.
How to Reach Varanasi from Ahmedabad?
There are several ways via which you can reach Varanasi from Ahmedabad. The holy city in UP is well-connected to the state of Gujarat , and you can use all three modes of transport to go there.

Luckily, there are direct flights from Ahmedabad to Kashi, and you can reach the holy city in just about 2 hours. Simply take a plane from Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport (Ahmedabad) and land at the Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, which is the nearest airport to Varanasi.
Several airlines like IndiGo, SpiceJet, Vistara, and Air India operate on this route regularly.

You can also book a Varanasi from Ahmedabad train package and travel in comfort and ease, and that too in budget. Trains like Sabarmati Express and Okha-Varanasi operate between Varanasi and Ahmedabad. You can reach the holy city from the state of Gujarat in about 24-28 hours.
You can also go from Ahmedabad to Varanasi by road. The journey takes around 24 hours and is ideal for people who love long road trips. You can use the NH27 and NH31 for this journey.
Route Map from Ahmedabad to Varanasi
The distance between Ahmedabad and Varanasi is around 1,350 km. Here's the Ahmedabad to Varanasi Route Map:
Ahmedabad → Ujjain → Bhopal → Rewa → Prayagraj → Varanasi
The journey is quite scenic, taking you through the lush areas of the state of Madhya Pradesh.
Here are some things that must be a part of your Varanasi Yatra package from Ahmedabad:

Visiting Kashi Vishwanath Temple must be a part of any Varanasi tour itinerary. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, this temple is one of the 12 Jyotirlingas. While you're in the city, you can also go on a full-blown Varanasi temple tour , with holy shrines like Annapurna Temple, Kal Bhairav Temple, Durga Temple, and more.

This is one of the most important things to do when visiting the holy city. Dashashwamedh Ghat and Assi Ghat are the best places to enjoy this grand spectacle of an event. During the Aarti, the whole area is lit with bright lamps, making it a sight to behold.

Come to Assi Ghat for enjoying a serene boat ride. Go there early in the morning (a little before sunrise) to have the best views. This will be one of the most beautiful experiences of your entire Varanasi pilgrimage tour from Ahmedabad.
While you're in Varanasi, don't miss the chance to go to Sarnath, which is located just 10 km outside Varanasi. This is the very place where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon.
Varanasi is famous all over the country for Banarasi Silk Sarees. So do shop for them in the popular markets. Also, it's a great place to buy religious items like Rudraksha beads, idols and more.

From Indore to Ujjain- You can reach Ujjain by taxi (1.5 h), train (1-1.5 h), or bus (2 h).
Driving from Chennai to Ujjain takes 22–24 hours. Take breaks for rest and food, and be ready for tolls.
No direct buses are available. You can take a bus from Chennai to Indore, then take a bus or taxi to Ujjain.
Chennai → Bangalore → Hyderabad → Nagpur → Indore → Ujjain
Best Time to Visit Ujjain from Chennai
Chennai to Ujjain best season is from October to March when weather is cool and pleasant-
Weather - With temperatures from 12°C to 30°C it's a great time to explore the city.
Festivals & Events - Experience the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga rituals and enjoy local festivals.
Tips- These months are popular among pilgrims so plan your travel and book accommodations in advance to avoid any problems.
If you're planning a trip, don't miss the best places to visit near Ujjain for an unforgettable experience-

Kal Bhairav Temple is one of Ujjain's most famous temple. It is known for its unique tradition, where devotees offer alcohol to the God, a ritual you won't find in most Indian temples. The temple is near the Shipra River, which has a beautiful and peaceful view. Visiting this place is a truly unforgettable experience for anyone traveling to Ujjain.
Meghdoot Resort Water Park and Club

Meghdoot Resort Water Park and Club in Ujjain is a great place for families and friends to enjoy a fun day. The water park has exciting water slides, pools, and areas where kids and adults can have lots of fun. After playing in the water, guests can relax in the resort's comfortable rooms, enjoy delicious meals at the restaurant, or try sports and games in the open areas. It's a perfect spot for a memorable day.

Ujjain is known for the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Temple. As one of the 12 Jyotirlingas, the daily Bhasma Aarti is a special ritual you shouldn't miss. The temple is full of positive energy, and many visitors feel a spiritual experience they've never had before. The temple is decorated with beautiful artwork, and its design impresses everyone who visits.

Vishnu Sagar Talab in Ujjain is a historic pond surrounded by temples and old buildings. It was used for water and religious rituals. Today, visitors come to enjoy the calm pond and see the beautiful heritage around. It's also a great place for taking photos. During festivals, the area fills with people celebrating and enjoying the events.
Best Travel Tips for Ujjain Tour
Before going to Ujjain just keep some important things in mind for a good journey-
Ujjain is a holy city. Wear modest clothes at temples. Women can wear Sarees, Salwar Kameez or simple clothes and men should avoid sleeveless shirts.
Ujjain is safe city overall but be careful in busy spots. Keep your wallet, phone and bag close to you in markets and temples.
Early morning visits are peaceful, less crowded and better time for Darshan.
Some temples don't allow photography inside so follow instructions.
FAQs about Ujjain Travel Package from Chennai
Q-1: How far is Ujjain from Chennai?
Ans: The distance between Chennai and Ujjain is about 1666 km. People go by flight to save time, but the journey by road or train can be very scenic.
Q-2: Are there any local foods or snacks to try in Ujjain?
Ans: Yes! Try Poha, Jalebi, Kachori at Sarafa Bazaar and traditional Thalis at local restaurants.

Ans: Ujjain is well-known for its old temples especially the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga. It is one of India's most important pilgrimage city and is famous for its history, spiritual atmosphere and festivals like the Kumbh Mela held every 12 years.
Q-4: How many days are enough for a complete Ujjain Tour?
Ans: Usually 3 - 4 days are enough to see temples, Ghats and nearby places.

blocks.text: Excited for your Nainital tour package from Delhi? Experience the charm of this beautiful hill station on our amazing 3-day trip. See More
It is a popular place across India. Known as the "Lake City of Uttarakhand," Nainital is famous for its scenic lakes and surrounding hills. Visitors love spending time boating on Naini Lake.

Early morning here is truly magical filled with peace and fresh mountain air. On clear days, you can see the snow covered Trishul and Nanda Devi peaks. Besides lake and mountains, you can explore pine forests, visit old temples, well-known ashrams and local markets.

Adventure lovers can take part in rock climbing, zip lining, horse riding, and paragliding here. Even visitors who come for a short time often wish they could stay longer because Nainital is truly unforgettable. The best part is that it is close to New Delhi - a perfect choice for anyone looking for short break. Don't wait! Book your Nainital trip from Delhi today, refresh your mind and soul away from the city's hustle.
Why Choose Nainital Travel Package from Delhi
No matter where you are in Delhi we'll pick you up - from the airport, railway station or your house.
Travel in a Comfortable AC Vehicle
You will go from place to place in a cool, comfortable AC vehicle.
Clean and Convenient places to rest
Stay in neat and peaceful hotels close to the lake. Meals are included in package so you don't need to worry about food.
There is no strict timing on our trips - you are free to take your time and enjoy fully.
How to Reach Nainital from Delhi
You can travel from Delhi to Nainital in many ways, like by flight, train, or road, because Delhi has lots of transport options-
The nearest airport to Nainital is Pantnagar Airport, around 70 km away, and it takes about 2 to 2.5 hours. You can catch a flight from Delhi to Pantnagar and then take a taxi or bus to Nainital.
The nearest railway station to Nainital is Kathgodam that is 33 km away. You can take a train from Delhi to Kathgodam. From the station, you'll get shared taxis and buses that go to Nainital.
The road from Delhi to Nainital is about 296 km and takes 7 hours. If you're not confident driving in hills, you can hire a taxi.
Route Map from Delhi to Nainital
Delhi → Ghaziabad → Moradabad → Rampur → Haldwani → Kathgodam → Nainital
List of Places to Visit in Nainital
Nainital has amazing natural beauty and interesting places to visit. Whether you are with family, friends, or as a couple, there are suitable destinations for everyone-

Dinosaur Park in Nainital is a fun and exciting place, especially for kids. It has big dinosaur models that look very real. Kids and families will love it. It's both entertaining and a chance to learn about dinosaurs. Don't miss it if you're visiting with children.
Opening & Closing Time- 10:30 AM to 5:00 PM

Naini Lake is the main attraction of Nainital and one of the beautiful places to visit. You can take a calm boat ride while enjoying the hills around you. It's perfect for relaxing, clicking pictures, or just walking near the lake. You'll often see this place crowded with visitors.
Entry Fee- Pedal and rowing boats at Rs.120/hour; Gondola boat round trip at Rs.150.
Opening & Closing Time- 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM

Jeolikote is a nice little hill town close to Naini Lake. It's full of colorful butterflies, birds, and flowers. The place is calm and clean, not many tourist knows about this place, but it's worth visiting. Don't forget to explore this wonderful spot when you go to Nainital.

Naini Devi Temple, near Naini Lake, is a well-known shrine. People believe the eye of Goddess Parvati is in this temple. Many devotees visit from far away to pray. The temple has a peaceful atmosphere that gives comfort to visitors. You can also buy Prasad and Puja items from shops close by.
Opening & Closing Time- 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM

Nainital is pleasant all year, but winter and summer are the best times to visit. December to January is perfect for snow lovers and honeymoon couples, while summer attracts adventure lovers and nature fans. If you plan to visit Nainital, go in summer and book at least 1- 2 weeks in advance.

mainEntity.name: Can I book online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can! All of our trips are available for online booking. Simply select your preferred travel date(s), and you're good to go! If you prefer, you can also book over the phone.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, this tour is private. No other travelers will join your group, ensuring a personalized experience just for you group.

mainEntity.name: Can the Driver speak Hindi or English?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Drivers can speak in Hindi and Regional Language. Our drivers understand basic English phrases, which should be sufficient for regular communication during the tour. We also provide complimentary city guides in major cities. However, if you prefer a fluent English-speaking driver, we recommend booking a professional guide to ensure smooth communication. Additionally, we offer guides fluent in languages such as French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, Russian, and German, available at an extra cost. mainEntity.name: .Does the Driver Know All the Attractions and Places for Sightseeing?

mainEntity.name: Will the Taxi and Driver be with us always?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Taxi and Driver will be at your Service from the Start till the End of the Tour.

mainEntity.name: Can I Use the Car After 8 PM?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the specific tour, but generally, we do not allow the taxi and driver to be on duty after 8 PM. This is to ensure that the driver gets adequate rest and is ready for the next day's activities.

mainEntity.name: Does the Taxi Have Roof Carriers for Luggage?

mainEntity.name: How Can I Rely on Your Company?

We are an approved travel company with accreditations from IATA, IATO, ABTO, and more. We have built a strong reputation and have successfully served over 100,000 tourists, ensuring reliability and quality service.

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no specified time duration for stops at each landmark. Since this is a private tour, you have the freedom to spend as much time as you wish at each location. You can also shorten the tour by skipping certain places or making quick visits.

mainEntity.name: Can I Make Customizations on the Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, since this is a private tour, customizations are possible based on your arrival/departure times, duration of stay, and personal interests. Feel free to reach out to your travel expert to discuss your specific needs.

mainEntity.name: How Long Before Do I Need to Book the Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book the tour at any time, even up to 3 days before your departure. However, it's advisable to book early to ensure you secure the same hotel and preferred accommodations.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth going to the Golden Triangle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Golden Triangle is worth visiting because it includes 3 popular cities like Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur, where you will explore amazing sights and it's a great way to experience India’s rich culture and history in a short trip.

mainEntity.name: What adventure activities visitors should try on a Delhi tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Delhi, visitors can try many adventure activities, like hot air balloon rides for a unique view of the city. In Gurgaon, rock climbing in the Aravalli hills is also a perfect option. Apart from this, bungee Jumping at Adventure Island in Rohini is also the best part to enjoy.

mainEntity.name: What is the best time to visit the Golden Triangle Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The perfect time is between October to March when the climate is cooler and more pleasant.

mainEntity.name: What are the other best places to explore in Jaipur?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travelers must explore Panna Meena Ka Kund due to its beautiful well with unique architecture and a peaceful atmosphere. Moti Dungri Fort is also nice and a small fort with lovely views of Jaipur which is rarely crowded.

mainEntity.name: What Is The Golden Triangle’s Significance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The national capital, New Delhi, and the cities of Agra and Jaipur are connected by a tourist route known as the “golden triangle” of India. The three states of Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan make a triangular shape on a map, hence the moniker “Golden Triangle.”

mainEntity.name: When Is The Ideal Time Of Year To Visit The Golden Triangle In India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Since there will be a lot of walking involved, the best time to visit the Golden Triangle is from October to mid-April, when temperatures vary from 22 to 32 °C. Delhi may endure frigid spells in January and February and hot 45°C temperatures in May and June as a result of the Himalayan influence.

mainEntity.name: Why Is The Golden Triangle In India Called That?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Golden Triangle got its name because gold was originally stored here. Gold was used for more than only transporting goods to Delhi and Agra; it was also used to make ornaments and coins, among other things.

mainEntity.name: .Is A Trip To The Golden Triangle Worthwhile?

acceptedAnswer.text: This area of history-rich jungle and foggy mountains is well-known for its history of opium cultivation. Even though the Golden Triangle is a well-known tourist site nowadays, it is still highly recommended.

mainEntity.name: .How Many Days Would You Need In India’s Golden Triangle?

acceptedAnswer.text: When Can You See the Golden Triangle? Most visitors decide to travel the entire Golden Triangle in three to seven days, but I strongly advise at least a week.

blocks.text: Kerala is a magnificent masterpiece of nature, enriched with the cultures and traditions of the local folks. See More

The captivating hill stations, waterfalls, and backwaters with flourishing wildlife sanctuaries have made it one of the most enthralling destinations. Every traveler around the world dreams of a Kerala and Tamil Nadu holiday. With our Kerala tour with Tamil Nadu, you can explore the famous attractions of these southernmost states and indulge in many interesting activities.

Our packages cater to the needs of families, couples, and solo travellers. You can customize the packages according to your unique needs and have tailored experiences. From accommodation to food and transportation to mind-blowing activities, we have included everything essential.

items: Tour Name Kerala & Tamil Nadu Travel Package

Pickup Time Depend on your Flight Timing
Tour Benefits Best price & enjoyable travel guarantee
Visit Tea Estates, Spice Plantation, Rose Garden, Blossom Park, and Honey Bee Plant of Munnar.
Seek the blessings of Lord Shiva at Ramanathaswamy Temple.
Houseboat cruise over the Backwater of Alleppey.
Witness the wildlife diversity and appreciate the breathtaking panoramas.
Your tour will start as you reach Cochin Airport/Railway Station.
After relaxing for some time, you will get ready to visit the famous destinations of Cochin, including St. Francis Church, Jewish Synagogue, and Fort Kochi.
Have an overnight stay at your hotel after the sightseeing tour.
After a delicious breakfast, you will be transferred to Munnar, one of the most famous hill stations of Kerala.
Explore spice plantations, well-organized tea gardens, and lush green forests.
After arriving at Munnar, you will check in to your pre-booked hotel and spend the rest of the day as you like, exploring the picturesque surroundings.
Have an overnight stay at your hotel in Munnar.

blocks.text: Today you will visit the famous sites of Munnar:

items: Echo Point: Echo Point is the place where your voice echoes.
Kundala Lake: It is a scenic tourist place. The area has Cherry Blossom trees, adding to this place’s beauty. It is one of the most famous spots for photography.

Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park): It houses a large population of Nilgiri Tahr. People often visit this site to see the Neelakurinji flowers, which bloom once every twelve years. It is spread over 92 square kilometers and houses a wide range of flora and fauna.
Have an overnight stay at your hotel in Munnar.
After a delicious breakfast, you will head to Thekkady.
Once you have arrived at Thekkady, you will check into your pre-reserved hotel and relax for some time.
In the afternoon, you will embark on a sightseeing tour. You will visit the Periyar wildlife sanctuary. In 1978, this thick evergreen forest was declared a Tiger Reserve.
You can also enjoy various adventurous activities in Thekkady. You can visit pepper, cardamom, tea & coffee plantations and enjoy a boat cruise on the Periyar lake.
You will enjoy cultural programmes such as Kathakali & Kalarippayattu in the evening and visit the Spice market.
You will then return to your hotel and have an overnight stay.
After a delicious breakfast, you will embark on a scenic drive to Alleppey, which is also known as Alappuzha.
Once you have arrived at Alleppey, you will check into the houseboat and enjoy the backwater life.
As you enjoy the cruise, you will witness the village area and canals. You will have dinner, breakfast, lunch, and evening tea at the houseboat.
After the tasty dinner, you will have an overnight stay at your houseboat.
Have a tasty breakfast in the morning, and then you will head to Kovalam.
If you have time on hand, you will visit Sri Padmanabha Temple in Trivandrum (which is considered to be the capital of Kerala).

Later on, you will embark on a drive to Kovalam, an internationally renowned beach that has three adjacent crescent beaches. It is considered to be the favourite of tourists for herbal massages, swimming, and relaxing on the beach.
Once you have arrived at Kovalam, you will check into your pre-booked hotel. You can spend the entire day relaxing at the beach.
You can enjoy various activities such as skiing, surfing, kayaking, and swimming.
You will have an overnight stay at your hotel in Kovalam.
Post breakfast, our driver will transfer you to Kanyakumari.
Once you have arrived at Kanyakumari, you will check in at your pre-booked hotel.
You will then visit Vivekananda Rock, where you will find a memorial that is dedicated to Swami Vivekananda.
From the tip of India, you can enjoy the sunset of Kanyakumari. Return to your hotel and have an overnight stay.
Embark on a drive to Rameshwaram.
Rameshwaram is known for its spiritual and historic relevance.
As per the legend, this is believed to be the site where Lord Rama built a bridge to rescue his consort Sita from Ravana.
After arriving at Rameshwaram, you will check into your hotel, and later you will head to Agnitheertham, Ramjharoka Temple, and Ramanathaswamy Temple.
You will have an overnight stay in Rameshwaram.
Take a holy dip in Agni Theertham early in the morning, and then you will head out for Spatika Lingam Darshan, which is also known as Mani Darshan.
After the Darshan and holy bath, you will return to your hotel and have breakfast. You will then head out for a sightseeing tour of Rameshwaram.
You will visit the famous attractions, including Five-faced Hanuman Temple, Kothandaramaswamy Temple, Ramar Patham, Gandamadana Parvatham, Rama Setu, and Dhanushkodi.
Have an overnight stay at your hotel in Rameshwaram.
Post breakfast, you will check out from your hotel and drive back to Madurai.
On the way, you will visit the Pamban Rail Scissors Bridge and the Pamban Bridge.
Once you have reached Madurai, you will check into your hotel.
Fresh up and then get ready to visit Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple and Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple.
After Darshan, you will return to your hotel and have an overnight stay.

Relish a yummy breakfast, and then you will check out from your hotel and you will be transferred to Madurai railway station or Airport, from where you will continue your journey to your next destination.

blocks.text: Embarking on a spiritual journey to Kedarnath from Ahmedabad is an enriching experience that allows you to connect with your inner self amidst the tranquil Himalayan landscape. Kedarnath, situated in Uttarakhand, holds immense religious significance as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and is revered as the abode of Lord Shiva. To cater to the needs of devotees and travellers from Ahmedabad, a range of thoughtfully crafted Kedarnath tour packages are available.

These Kedarnath Yatra packages offer a comprehensive itinerary that includes transportation, accommodation, meals, and guided tours, ensuring a hassle-free pilgrimage experience. Whether you prefer a leisurely trip or an adventurous journey, there are packages to suit every requirement. The tour packages provide an opportunity to explore not only the famous Kedarnath Temple but also other significant attractions in the region. Along with the temple visit, you can witness the architectural marvel of the Bhairavnath Temple and embark on treks to picturesque spots like Vasuki Tal and Chandrashila.

For those seeking convenience, helicopter services are available for easy and quick access to Kedarnath. Helicopter bookings can be included in the tour packages, providing a bird’s-eye view of the breathtaking landscape. To ensure a seamless pilgrimage, the Uttarakhand government has made it mandatory to register for the Kedarnath Yatra. The tour packages assist in completing the registration process, saving you time and effort. Choosing a Kedarnath tour package from Ahmedabad, you can embark on a spiritual odyssey, immerse yourself in the divine atmosphere, and create lasting memories of this sacred pilgrimage. These packages offer convenience, comfort, and an opportunity to explore the awe-inspiring beauty of the Himalayas, making your journey truly unforgettable.

Kedarnath holds a special place in Hindu mythology and is considered one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, the sacred abodes of Lord Shiva. Legend has it that the temple was built by the Pandavas from the Mahabharata epic to seek forgiveness from Lord Shiva. The main attraction of Kedarnath is the ancient Kedarnath Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva. The temple’s unique architecture, made of massive stones, and its spiritual ambiance make it a must-visit destination for devotees and spiritual seekers alike.
Best Places to Visit in Kedarnath

items: Kedarnath Temple: The Kedarnath Temple is the primary attraction in the town. Devotees believe that a visit to this temple can cleanse their sins and grant them salvation. The temple, surrounded by snow-capped peaks, offers a sense of tranquillity and spirituality.

Bhairavnath Temple: Located just a kilometre away from the Kedarnath Temple, the Bhairavnath Temple is dedicated to Lord Bhairav, who is believed to be the protector of the holy shrine. It is an important stop for pilgrims during the Kedarnath Yatra.

Vasuki Tal: Situated at a height of 4,150 meters, Vasuki Tal is a picturesque glacial lake surrounded by snow-clad mountains. The trek to Vasuki Tal is a popular activity among adventure enthusiasts and offers a mesmerizing natural landscape.

Chandrashila: Situated at an altitude of 4,000 meters, Chandrashila offers awe-inspiring panoramic views of the Himalayan peaks, including Nanda Devi, Trishul, and Chaukhamba. It is a favourite spot for trekkers and nature lovers.

Registration: To ensure a smooth and organized pilgrimage, it is mandatory to register for the Kedarnath Yatra. The registration process can be done online, and it helps in managing the flow of devotees and maintaining the security and safety of the pilgrimage site.

Fitness and Acclimatization: The journey to Kedarnath involves trekking at high altitudes, so it is important to be physically fit. It is advisable to engage in regular exercise and acclimatize yourself to high altitudes before embarking on the Yatra.

Weather and Clothing: Kedarnath experiences cold weather throughout the year. It is essential to carry warm clothing, including jackets, woollen caps, gloves, and sturdy shoes. It is also recommended to carry raincoats and umbrellas during the monsoon season.
Medications and First Aid: Carry necessary medications and a basic first aid kit, including pain relievers, altitude sickness medicines, Band-Aids, antiseptic creams, and any prescribed medicines.

blocks.text: The best time to visit Kedarnath is during the summer months from May to June and September to October. The weather during this time is pleasant, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 30°C. It is advisable to avoid the monsoon season as heavy rainfall may lead to landslides and roadblocks, making the journey difficult and unsafe.

To reach Kedarnath, you can choose from various transportation options. The most common route is to first reach Haridwar or Rishikesh by train or road from major cities like Delhi or Ahmedabad. From there, you can hire a taxi or take a bus to reach Gaurikund, the base camp for the Kedarnath trek. From Gaurikund, you have the option to undertake a 16-kilometers trek or book a helicopter ride to reach Kedarnath.

blocks.text: Half of Goa is Covered in Forest

items: You will be amazed to know that over a third of Goa is covered in forest. Goa is a very popular beach destination, but one-third of it is nestled in the beautiful Western Ghats of India.
It is also the best place to visit for nature lovers and honeymoon couples. The forest of Goa is teeming with amazing wildlife.
Goa is India's smallest state, but don't let the size fool you. Goa is a compact treasure chest of adventures, beaches, bars, markets, and luxury resorts.
It might be the tiniest state in India, but its spirit is abundant, as you will get tons of activities to do here and create wonderful memories with your loved ones.

blocks.text: Goa, Once Ruled by the Portuguese

items: For over 450 years, Goa was under the rule of the Portuguese. So, the Portuguese have a great influence on the fabric of daily life of the Goans.

You will feel the Portuguese influence in architecture, food, way of life, cafes, language, surnames, culture, and festivals because when the Portuguese arrived in Goa in 1510, they made it their capital.
Goa Carnival is India's only traditional Latin carnival, which is celebrated with great pomp and show for four days in February or March.

It is celebrated with delightful music programs, dance, and costume parades. The roots of this festival are Christian, but its spirit is Indian. People from all backgrounds are allowed to witness this festival.
We all know that India got independence on 15th August 1947, but Goans did not get independence from the Portuguese on this date. They had to wait a little longer.

Goa got independence on December 19th, 1961, and joined the Indian union. This is the reason why Goa has the privilege to celebrate two independence days. One with the entire nation and another on December 19th by honoring the heroes who fought for their freedom.

blocks.text: Best Time to Visit Goa for Holidays

November to February is the best time to visit Goa for enjoying holidays with your family and friends. The weather will be pleasant to enjoy scenic views, relaxation at beaches and outdoor adventure activities. Let's know in details about the best time to visit Goa-

Winter is the best time to plan your Goa trip whether you are family with kids, couples or solo travellers. The weather will be pleasant for outdoor adventures, sightseeing, beach parties and enjoying nightlife .

In summers Goa is less crowded. Only tourists who love the vibe of Goa, reach here to enjoy sightseeing despite the hot weather. It is a great time to explore Goa for budget travellers. You can enjoy sightseeing and outdoor activity swimming, rafting, boat rides, Scuba diving etc.

If you are tolerant of heavy rains then visit Goa during this time. You will see lush landscapes and the cool breeze will soothe your soul. Heavy rains might disrupt your sightseeing plans. But you will witness Calm, quiet beaches, and green countryside; lower prices for stays.

It's the best time to plan your vacation in Goa and book amazing Goa Tour Packages before the crowd returns in peak season. It's a good month for sightseeing and enjoying outdoor activities for budget travellers, couples and solo travellers.
Best Places to Explore in Goa on Your Trip

In 2025, in the first six months, Goa welcomed around 5.45 million tourists. Of these tourists, about 5.18 million were domestic tourists and approximately 271,000 were international tourists. Source: The Print . Here is a list of the best places to visit in Goa-

items: A UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goa. It is one of the most popular places to visit in Goa. Built in the 16th century, this church houses the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.
The Baroque architecture of the church will take your breath away.
It's a majestic four-tiered waterfall on the Goa-Karnataka border. You will be mesmerized to see its beauty.
This place attracts many honeymoon couples. The milky white water flowing through lush greenery is a sight worth capturing.
Don't miss the most famous and lively beaches of Goa. Not a single moment is dull here.

You will enjoy the vibrant atmosphere with golden sands, numerous water sports like jet skiing, parasailing, banana boat rides, and dolphin cruises, and the exciting nightlife hotspots like Tito's and Mambo's.
Situated at the confluence of the Mandovi River and Arabian Sea, Fort Aguada is one of the most popular heritage attractions to explore in Goa.

The main highlight of this fort is its sturdy laterite stone walls, which are 5 meters high and 1.3 meters thick, a 4-storey lighthouse and an enormous water cistern. Enjoy the most scenic sunset views here.

blocks.text: A beach and warm weather are all I really need." - Rob Gronkowski

When we think about Goa, the first thing that pops into our minds is the fantastic sights of beaches because life feels less boring around beaches. In the words of Sandy Gingras, "Time on beaches doesn't move hour to hour but mood to moment." Beaches of Goa restore the liveliness of the soul. You must visit some of these beaches once in a lifetime in Goa.

items: Vagator Beach- It has a beautiful crescent-shaped bay, which is the most beautiful sight to capture. It is very famous for its small coves.

Candolim Beach- Before exploring other beaches of Goa, people always prefer Candolim Beach as their first choice. Here you can unwind under parasols with your loved ones and enjoy a fun-filled picnic. Also, savor delicious seafood in beach shacks.

Calangute Beach- It is Goa's most famous beach to visit for a relaxing vacation with your family. It is packed with amazing restaurant shacks, shopping points, nightclubs, and scenic and comfortable accommodation options. You can also enjoy a variety of water adventure activities here.

Baga Beach- It is one of the busiest beaches of North Goa. You can enjoy exciting water adventure activities in Baga Beach, like jet-skiing, banana boat rides, swimming, water skiing, etc. Its delightful shores are filled with popular eating joints and bars.

Agonda Beach -Enjoy swimming and engage in exciting water sports, especially canoeing, as it is one of the best activities to do here. You can also visit the turtle center to watch Olive Ridley Turtle eggs.
Majorda Beach- Peaceful and scenic, Majorda is one of the less crowded beaches of South Goa. You can enjoy a soothing horse ride on this beach.

Palolem Beach- It is one of the loveliest beaches of South Goa. Enjoy a lovely stay at scenic tree houses and campsites. Enjoy the soothing boat rides offered by fishermen for dolphin-watching and sunset views.
Varca Beach -It's a perfect beach spot to laze under the sun. Enjoy local boat rides offered by fishermen, or go for a cruise over the Sal River to spot dolphins.

Cola Beach- Cola Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches of South Goa. It has beautiful coconut groves and Rajasthani-style tents. There is a freshwater lagoon to try swimming and other water adventures.

blocks.text: Goa's fun-filled vibe attracts tourists from all over the world. Here are some of the most famous nightclubs to experience the best of Goa's night tourism.

items: Club Cabana -Don't miss this multi-level open-air nightclub, Club Cabana, which is also known as 'Nightclub in the Sky.' Several bar areas and a beautiful waterfall cascading into an open-air pool make this club the best to enjoy nightlife. Only couples are allowed in this club. So, if you are on honeymoon in Goa, then you can visit this club.

Club Tito's-Club Tito's is a lifeline of Baga Beach. Every Saturday, the dance floor comes alive on retro and Bollywood hits. When the clock strikes 11pm, the soundscape changes to hip-hop and techno music.

Sinq Night Club -It is one of the best places to enjoy for party lovers. There are four entertainment zones in this club-a chic nightclub, a bistro, a poolside deck, and private cabanas-making it an ultimate paradise for party lovers.
Leopard Valley-Don't miss this awe-inspiring open-air venue, Leopard Valley. It has a 22 ft high DJ stage where you can enjoy the best of EDM. Enjoy 3D laser night shows and parties on Friday nights.

blocks.text: Goa tourism is beyond beaches, sunsets, and adventures, as the calendar is also painted with exciting events to celebrate and introduce to the world the music, food, culture, and heritage of Goa. Every month, there is something to enjoy in Goa. Here is a list of some popular events to visit in Goa:

items: Heritage Festival of Goa (January)- It's a three-day Heritage Festival held in January by Goa Tourism. The festival showcases the culture, folklore, music, lifestyle, and traditions of Goa, which have been passed on from one generation to another.
Sensorium (Jan to March)- It is a must-visit place for every art and heritage lover. You will absolutely love the exhibition of arts, cinema, and music at Sunaparanta.
Grape Escapade (April)- This festival is celebrated in the month of April for four days in Panaji with many amazing culinary delights, wine tasting sessions, and grape stomping.

International Film Festival (November)- It is one of the grand international film festivals of India, celebrated in Goa in November. This festival celebrates and honors cinema by screenings of Indian and international films.

Zagor Festival (Dec)- Zagor Fest is a traditional folk-dance drama in Goa, celebrated to protect the harvest from destruction. You will see midnight processions of the village deity Zagoryo. Enjoy folk performances, village feats, and prayers.

blocks.text: Best Things to Do in Goa on Your Trip

Goa is a versatile destination and has many things to do. Not a single moment in Goa will be boring as it has something for every type of traveller. Mentioned here are some of the best activities to do in Goa to enjoy Goa Tourism-
Enjoy Water adventure activities at Various Beaches

items: Goa is a very famous beach destination so, one of the best activities to do here is enjoying water adventure activities. Try activities like jet skiing, parasailing, banana boat rides, scuba diving, and kayaking at famous beaches of Goa such as Baga, Calangute, Anjuna, and Candolim.
The activities in beaches are family friendly. If you are a beginner, you can hire experienced instructors to enjoy activities.

blocks.text: Enjoy Shopping in Flea markets and Bazaars

items: Goa is a very lively destination to enjoy with family. It is also one of the most loved spots for shoppers.

You can enjoy shopping at some of the most famous flea markets like Anjuna, Arpora Saturday Night Market, Mapusa Market and Bazaars like Calangute Market, Panjim and 18th June road for souvenirs, clothes, jewelry, decor, and artisan products.

blocks.text: Witness the Rich Heritage of Goa

items: Goa has many amazing heritage destinations perfect for cultural enthusiasts, families and history buffs. Most of the heritage monuments here represent centuries of Indo-Portuguese culture and artistic achievement.
Explore Palácio do Deão, Fort Aguada, Basilica of Bom Jesus, Our Lady of The Immaculate Conception Church and Fernandes Heritage House.
Goan Bakeries reflects the rich Portuguese culinary heritage which you must know if you are in Goa.
Explore some of the top bakeries in Goa like Myles High Bakehouse, Simona's Bakery, German Bakery, Padaria Prazeres etc.

Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary is one of the must visit places if you are in Goa for enjoying thrilling wildlife and capturing scenic nature views. Its rich tropical forests are teeming with wildlife. You will spot leopards, elephants, Indian bison (gaur), deer, Malayan giant squirrels, and over 120 species of birds.
There are also many beautiful places to explore like Dudhsagar Waterfalls, Devil's Canyon viewpoint, Tambdi Falls, and the ancient Tambdi Surla Mahadev Temple.
In Goa, you will experience both Indian and Portuguese culinary heritage. You will enjoy Goa's seafood tossed with distinctive spices, and the sweet-and-savory flavors.
You must note these famous foods in Goa such as Goan Fish curry, Pork Vindaloo, Prawn Balchao, Bebinca, Chicken Shagoti, Patoleo, Crab Xacuti and Sorpotel.

blocks.text: How to Reach Goa by Air, Rail and Road

If you opt for flight, it will be the fastest travel mode to reach Goa. Trains along the scenic Konkan coast will be preferred by budget conscious travellers most of the time. Tourists also opt for road trips to Goa from Mumbai and Pune which allows for flexible scenic sightseeing stops along the route. Here is a detailed outline of How to reach Goa by Air, Train and Road-

rows: Goa International Airport (Dabolim, GOI) and Mopa Airport (North Goa). These airports are the nearest airports to reach Goa. Dabolim is 29–32 km from Panaji, allowing both domestic and international flights.

Goa has good flight accessibility. You will get direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Ahmadabad, Pune. International flights from Abu Dhabi, Muscat, Sharjah, Doha, Dubai, Kuwait, Singapore
Delhi-Goa: 2.5 hr.; Mumbai-Goa: 1 hr.; Bengaluru-Goa: 1 hr.
There are two main railway stations: Madgaon (Margao, MAO) and Vasco-da-Gama (VSG) to reach Goa.
Major trains to reach Goa are- Konkan Kanya Express, Mandovi Express, Goa Sampark Kranti Express (Delhi-Goa), Amaravathi Express (Kolkata), Nizamuddin Goa Express (Delhi via Pune).
Mumbai-Goa: 8–12 hr.; Delhi-Goa: 25 hr.; Bengaluru-Goa: 15 hr.

You can reach Goa via NH-66 (Mumbai-Goa), NH-48 & NH-4A (Bangalore), NH-366, NH-566. You can also opt for Multiple deluxe AC and regular bus services from Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Belgaum, Kolhapur, Mangalore. Also enjoy self-drive with friends and witness scenic spots along the way to reach Goa.
You will get direct buses from Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore. From Mumbai, Goa is (600 km), Pune (450 km), Bengaluru (560 km), Mangalore (370 km), Belgaum (150 km), Hyderabad (660 km).
Mumbai-Goa: 12–14 hr.; Bengaluru-Goa: 9–11 hr.; Pune-Goa: 9 hr.

blocks.text: Jaipur was founded by Sawai Raja Jai Singh and is the capital of Rajasthan. Jaipur city has evolved into a great travel attraction in India and is one of the top three cities for being acclaimed Golden Triangle Tour along with Agra, the city of Taj, and Delhi, the capital of India. While traveling Jaipur tours you can visit the historical forts, flaunting palaces, full-of-life temples, brindle bazaars, and bouncy streets that have earned a special place in the hearts of the people. The uniqueness lies in the rusty pink color that envelops all the designs and the construction of the building has earned the city thus used the name, ‘The Pink City’. The pink color is meant to ‘welcome’ the Prince of Wales in 1876 and was beheld by the ruler Ram Singh II as a capable scientific way to cut down the biting blaze of the sun.

That was compulsory for everybody who was living in the old city to maintain this uniqueness of the city. The name of this city ‘Jaipur’ has dual attention – ‘Jai’ means victory and was also the first name of its maker while ‘pur’ meant city. The Govind Devji Temple is perhaps the most brilliant in the city while Galtaji Temple has natural springs to bluster it. There are three immense forts in the city Nahargarh Fort, Amber Fort, and Jaigarh Fort. The famous Jal Mahal is a perfect royal retreat while the extended castle of the City Palace recreated the times of Kings and Queens with its hilly exteriors and tasteful interiors. Hawa Mahal also become the icon of Jaipur tours.

Jaipur is one of the most famous tourist places in India. Every year, this city greets many people from all over the world. My Quick Trippers provides this incredible tour along with other services like hotel accommodations, transportation, a guide, etc. This place has an amazing land of royal forts & palaces.

blocks.text: Nestled between China, India, Laos and Thailand, Myanmar is a fairy tale land of Buddhist temples, gold-leaf tombs and towering pagodas with 1200 mile long coastal line having many enchanting places to attract people on Tour Packages. On Tour Package to Myanmar tourists enjoy historical sites, cultural heritage, archeological zone, traditions and beautiful country side and beaches. Beautiful country of Myanmar is surrounded by mountains and dotted with some tranquil lakes and is an absorbing place to be on Tour Package for people interested in history, heritage and natural beauty.

Yangon is the largest city of this country and has many places to tempt visitors on Tour Package. Shwedagon Pagoda is the biggest attraction of this city and truly a mesmerizing structure which was mentioned by famous writer Rudyard Kipling as ‘winking wonder’. This pagoda is 2500 years old construction and covered with 60 tons of gold, the tip of this pagoda is set with diamonds, ruby and sapphire and the hue diamond at the topmost point of the tip is believed to catch first and last sunlight ray of the day. Other attractions of Yangon for tourists on Myanmar Tour Package are Sule and Botataung Pagoda, Mahapasana cave and the City Hall.

The Golden Rock or Kyaikhtiyo is an important place for pilgrimage for all Buddhists and an inviting place for tourists on Myanmar Holiday Packages. The stupa at this place has a hair of Lord Buddha which makes it sacred place for all, this stupa is covered in a Gold leaf balancing on the tip of cliff. The mesmerizing view and its religious importance make it a popular attraction of Myanmar Tour Packages.

Ngwe Saung beach is close to Yangon and easily accessible by cars and cruise, one can see enchanting view of Irrawaddy Delta on the way and can submerse himself in sun, sea and sand on this cleanest beach of the country. Activities like snorkeling, swimming, fishing, surfing or relaxing under shade of palm tress make it an attractive place to be on Myanmar Travel Packages.

Bagan is a World Heritage Site and a wonderful place to be with more than 3000 ancient temple and stupas built in 11th century, this place attracts record number of tourists on Tour Packages in Myanmar. It is impossible to choose any particular attraction of this place as this whole place is highly charming and fascinating yet some not to miss attractions of this place on Myanmar Holiday Packages with others are Shwe Zigon Stupa, Ananda Temple, Damayan Gyi Temple and Shwe Sandow Pagoda.

Inle Lake is the most picturesque place in entire country and must visit part of all Myanmar Tour Packages. Leg rowing technique of Intha people is another attraction of this place along with Phaung Dao Pagoda and Nga Pha Kyaung Monastery. Ngapali beach and Mount Popa are other attractive places with lots of natural charm to exhilarate tourists. Just 11 Km away from Mandalay is the large, placid Taungthaman Lake which is another natural and historical place to be. Kawthaung is at the Southernmost tip of Myanmar and has 800 island Archipelago, more than half of these islands belong to Myanmar and is beautiful bustling coastal town.

blocks.text: Let us have a brief understanding of exciting places to visit, activities to perform, and many more things that attract a tourist.

Start your journey in southern Bali, where you will find good beaches, sea sports, and interesting nightlife. You will find sunny streets in Kuta, beach clubs in Seminyak, and cliff temples in Uluwatu with the best sunset sights. The southern coast reveals the tropical atmosphere of the island. You may even go surfing on the beach, have dinner on the beach, or even get a spa on the sea.

Explore the interior and go to Bali, the cultural center and enjoy the green rice fields, the busy markets and the serene environment there. Yoga retreats, the famous fields of Tegalalang Rice Terraces and the terraced forest with concealed waterfall are all things that should be discussed. You should not forget to visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave), the Monkey Forest and to climb Mount Batur in the early morning.

The northern and eastern parts of Bali will be extra charming to discover. Lovina and Menjangan have black volcanic, sandy beaches, snorkeling spots, and colorful coral reefs. Visit some of unravelled waterfalls such as Gitgit waterfall in the forest in Bali. The Temple of the Gate of Heaven offers magnificent views in the mountainous eastern region, around Lempuyang.

Bali is referred to as the Island of the Gods since majority of the people there are Hindus. There are numerous temples all around the island. Others include Uluwatu Temple, Tanah Lot, and the massive Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park which is just outside the airport. Everyday life in Bali is connected with offerings, rituals, and customs, and they take place all over the island daily.

If you plan your holiday in Bali during the festive season, then you get to observe colorful local rites, cultural performances as well as art festivals. Bali Arts Festival (Pesta Kesenian Bali) is a celebration of local dances, music, and crafts practiced in the region annually. Besides this, the island celebrates a few special religious holidays, which include Nyepi and the Galungan and Kuningan holidays.

Whether it is sunny beach adventures or vibrant temple festivals, Bali has something special in any season. A family holiday is normally best during the dry season, which is between April and October. The sky is bright, the sun is lovely, and the sea is smooth, so this is a good opportunity to have delight in the beach, sightseeing, and adventure.

The reason is simple. There are two kinds of seasons in Bali namely, a dry season and a wet season, and each has a different feel to travelling. April to October is the dry season and the most appropriate time to visit the beach (Kuta, Seminyak, Nusa Dua), hike Mount Batur and outdoor activities. The wet season, November to March, includes tropical rainfalls, but it is also cheaper and less wet, hence you will be able to explore the Bali culture, rice terraces, and waterfalls.
The warm tropical climate is all year round, and this makes Bali always hospitable. Simply choose whether you will be going on sunny or relaxing trips with the rain-washed vegetation.

blocks.text: Bali Visa Guide for Indian Nationals

To move freely in Bali, you have to obtain a Visa on Arrival (VoA). This permit can only accommodate short stays of up to 30 days. It may be prolonged to 30 days. It will cost you approximately 2700 INR based on the exchange rate.
Note: You will need a valid passport with a minimum of 6 months' validity. Along with this, you would need a return flight ticket and accommodation proof, as well as sufficient money for your stay.

Bali does not have direct connectivity to land or sea, and therefore, you need to fly to reach it. You will depart with Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi (DEL) and land in the I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport in Denpasar (DPS). Delhi-Bali flights typically include a stop in a big Southeast Asian hub such as Bangkok, Singapore, or Kuala Lumpur.

Bali Travel Tips: 5 Things to Keep in Mind
There are certain tips and tricks that you must be aware if you are in Bali.

Visa on Arrival is available at the Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) in Bali to any Indian who holds an Indian passport. Carry cash in U.S. dollars in order to make a quick payment. Ensure that your passport has a life of six months.

You will be spending on Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Always have some cash around to use in small stores, markets and local restaurants. Cards are accepted in many tourist destinations and hotels, and may fail to work in the countryside.

Visit temples in Bali and wear nice clothes, like Tanah Lot or Uluwatu. At the entrance, the temples provide you with a sarong and a sash, although you can always bring yours. Always obey the local traditions.

The private transfers are easy, whereas to navigate the local streets, it is also possible to rent scooters (with an international driving permit). Always be careful on wide roads and always wear helmets.
Bali can get hot and humid; hence, prefer light clothes to help keep you cool. Always bring along bottled water, sunscreen, and hats. Do not use tap water and use bottled or filtered water.

blocks.text: One of the most visited places on Earth, the country of Cambodia boasts of rich history, tranquil and ancient temples and natural beauty to enchant tourists on Tour Packages throughout the year. The natural diversities, landscapes, culture and traditions of Cambodia are biggest attractions on Tour Packages.

Angkor Wat is the primary attraction for tourists on Tour Packages, with 50 towers ancient Angkor Wat Temple is a treat to watch situated at the center of the town. Huge pyramid of Takeo, in the center of the forest is Ta Prohm, King’s bathing pond Sras Srang, Banteay Kdei and an elegant temple of Prasat Kravan are other attractions of Angkor Wat. This fortified city has five monumental gates decorated by stone elephant trunks and each gate is 20 meter high, built in 7th Century this is a wonderful place to visit on Cambodia Tour Packages.

If one wants to see the natural beauty of Cambodia Ratanakiri is the best place to be. Dotted with hills, mountains, watershed lowlands, lakes created by craters and scenic waterfalls this place is captivating for nature lovers on Cambodia Holiday Packages. Kachang waterfall is a beautiful place with mist surrounding the place and water falling from a height to flow into river Sre Pok. Yeak Loam Lake is another natural attraction of this place, a serene natural spot with lots of greenery around the lake which was formed by volcanic eruption. Ratanakiri is a must visit place on Cambodia Tour Package.

Sihanoukville is a coastal town and place visited by tourists in bulk as it offers many enticing beaches for visitors on Tour Packages. Very wide and 1 Km long beach of Sokha is one of the favorite beaches of tourists on Cambodia Holiday Packages, this beach is so wide that one can relax and enjoy on sand even during high tides. Ochheuteal and Independence beach are other popular places to enjoy sun, sand, water and greenery of Cambodia.

Battambang is the second largest city of Cambodia with innumerable places to visit and best place to feel the cultural heritage of the country on Tour Packages. Situated on the banks of Sangker River this place has lakes, temples, ancient buildings, museums and many other places to see. Some of the premier attractions of the city includes, Barseat Temple, built in 11th century, it is an example of architectural excellence of Cambodian people and must see place on Cambodia Travel Packages. Wak Ek Temple Ba Nan Temple, Snung Pagoda and Prasat Snung are other popular attractions of this place not to be missed on Cambodia Tour Packages.

Cambodia Tour Package is not complete without exploring the beautiful and ancient city of Phnom Penh, situated at the meeting point of Mekong, Bassac and Tonle Sap River this city is reckoned as Gem of South East Asia due to its cultural richness and its beauty, charm and magical splendor. Some of the famous attractions of this city are the Royal Palace, situated on the banks of Mekong River this is a beautiful historic architecture, Prasat Neang Khmao also called as Temple of Black Virgin or Goddess Kali, the Silver Pagodas or Emerald Buddha and the National Museum exhibiting some exquisite collection of ancient Cambodian art.

blocks.text: Your Ujjain Tour Package from Pune will take you to one of India's most spiritual cities, filled with temples, Ghats, and positive energy. Whether tourists are from India or abroad, everyone comes to enjoy Ujjain's beautiful heritage.

It is called the city of Mahakal because of Mahakaleshwar Temple, one of the 12 Jyotirlingas. It is believed that whoever comes here with a pure heart is blessed by Lord Mahakal who fulfills their wishes. Apart from this Ujjain is famous for the Kumbh Mela, a big spiritual event held every 12 years.

Our trips cover not just main places but also hidden gems, local markets and yummy food places. Leave the planning to us. With our Pune to Ujjain tour package booking is easy, accommodations are the best, guides are experienced, transport is clean and well maintained, while every detail is handled so you can enjoy smooth and memorable journey.

There are plenty of destinations to explore in this city, known for its history and culture, where visitors can enjoy experiences they will always remember-

Ujjain's main highlight is the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Temple, specially known for its Bhasma Aarti. This ritual happens every morning before sunrise. Long ago, the sacred ash, called Vibhuti, used in the Aarti was prepared from human ashes taken from the Shamshaan Ghat (cremation ground) and applied on the Shivling.
Not many people know about this unique ritual. This temple is very old - it was built thousands of years ago. Travelers must visit here if they are in Ujjain.
Travel Tips- Photography inside the temple is not allowed.

Jantar Mantar, also called Vedh Shala, is a historic observatory in Ujjain. It was built by Maharaja Jai Singh in the 17th century to study stars and planets. It is the oldest of his five observatories - the others are in Delhi, Jaipur, Mathura, and Varanasi.

What makes it special is that all the instruments here are made of stone, not metal or modern machines. The instruments are so accurate that even today, they can show the exact positions of the sun, moon, and other planets. In the past, they were also used to tell time.
Travel Tips- Visit early in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat.

One of the most visited place in Ujjain is Ram Ghat, which is close to Harsiddhi Temple near the Shipra River. It is one of the oldest bathing Ghats and an important spot for the Kumbh Mela. Bathing in the river is refreshing, but the real magic happens in the evening Aarti at 8 PM, which gives a soulful experience that visitors should never miss. Tourists can see the lamps float on the river, and listen to the prayers and music that makes every visit truly special.
Travel Tips- Buy a small Diya and float it on the river - it's an unforgettable experience.

Bhartrihari Caves is a peaceful spot hidden in the hills where the famous poet and saint, Bhartrihari, lived and meditated. The caves have small spaces made into the rock where he might have rested or written his poems. Even in the heat outside, the cave stays cool, where you would enjoy meditating. Bhartrihari Caves is an unexplored spot that everyone should see.
Travel Tips- People with breathing or suffocation issues should avoid going inside the cave.

blocks.text: Overall, October to March is perfect for a trip to Ujjain , with cool weather and colorful festivals. Summers and monsoon months can be a little tricky for travel, but some travelers still enjoy visiting during this time.
How to Reach Ujjain from Pune
There are multiple ways to travel from Pune to Ujjain-

The nearest airport to Ujjain is Indore Airport (Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Airport ) about 55 km away. From Pune, you can take a direct flight to Indore. After landing, take a taxi, bus or cab to Ujjain (1.5-2 hours).
You can reach Ujjain by direct train. Rails from Pune to Ujjain Junction take 12-14 hours.
Ujjain is about 579 km from Pune. You can drive on NH52 and NH52B or take a bus.
Q-1: Is there Vande Bharat train from Pune to Ujjain?
Ans: At present, there is no direct Vande Bharat train from Pune to Ujjain. Travelers usually take a train to Indore or Bhopal and then continue the journey to Ujjain by taxi or cab.
Q-2: What is the distance from Ujjain Railway Station to Mahakaleshwar Temple?
Ans: It's just 1.4 km away, about a 10-minute drive by car.
Q-3: Is it safe to drive on the Pune to Ujjain route?
Ans: Yes, the highways are safe but night driving should be avoided.
Q-4: What is the toll cost for Pune to Ujjain drive?
Ans: The toll for driving from Pune to Ujjain is usually between ₹600 and ₹800 one way. It can change a little depending on highway.
Q-5: What is famous about Ujjain?

Ans: Ujjain is known for its old temples, sacred Ghats along the Shipra River, and colorful religious festivals. City is especially famous for Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, one of Lord Shiva's 12 Jyotirlingas, and for the Kumbh Mela where thousands of pilgrims come every year.

blocks.text: The best time to visit Varanasi is from October to March . The weather in this period is quite pleasant and therefore makes for a perfect time to come here and indulge in sightseeing & take part in the holy rituals that take place here.

Also, in November, the Ganga Mahotsav takes place, where you can witness the vibrant cultural performances and boat races!
February/March is another great time to come here as the Maha Shivratri is celebrated here with great enthusiasm, especially at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple.

How to Reach Varanasi from Delhi?
There are three modes of transport by which you can arrive in Varanasi:
By Air : Luckily, there are direct flights available from Delhi to Varanasi. And the holy city also has an airport, which will save you a lot of time. You can land there from Delhi in just 1.5 hours.

By Train : Varanasi tour by train is another great option. Express trains run from Delhi to Varanasi on a daily basis. You'll find trains like Kashi Vishwanath Express, Vande Bharat, and Shiv Ganga Express for this journey. You can book the ticket on the official website of IRCTC.
By Road : Those who love a road trip should take this land journey. The journey is about 820 km long and would take about 12-13 hours. Use the NH19 for this tour.

Q1. How to go to Varanasi from Delhi?

Ans. There are various ways by which you can go from Delhi to Varanasi. All three modes of transportation are available for this route: flight, train, and road. Direct flights from Delhi are available, and if you are going by train, then trains like the Kashi Vishwanath Express and Shiv Ganga Express are best! Road journey is another option. You can go by the NH 19, but it will take about 12 hours to get there.
Q2. What is the best time to visit Varanasi?

Ans. The best time to visit Varanasi is in the window of October to March. It's a perfect time to go for sightseeing here and cover your temple tour & enjoy Ganga Aartis. The weather in this period is quite pleasant and therefore makes for the perfect time for sightseeing.
Q3. How many days are enough to visit Varanasi?

Ans. Usually, two to three days are sufficient for a Varanasi trip. In this span, you can easily cover all the must-do activities and visit all the important places, like Dashashwamedh Ghat and Kashi Vishwanath Temple. In fact, in this duration, you can also visit the nearby popular place like Sarnath.
Q4. What local food should I try in Varanasi?

Ans. While you're there, definitely try the local popular dishes like Banarasi Paan, Kachori Sabzi, Rabri Jalebi, and Lassi. You can also try the Malaiyo in winter. Also, during your visit, do try the street food to get the real taste of Banarasi culture!
Q5. What is the cheapest way to travel from Delhi to Varanasi?

Ans. The cheapest way to travel from Delhi to Varanasi is hands down by the train. The ticket price starts at just INR 500 for the sleeper class. If you're on a budget, you can also opt for overnight trains and even buses.
Q6. What should I wear while visiting temples in Varanasi?

Ans. While visiting temples, you should wear modest clothes as they are a place of worship. Sarees, suits, or long dresses for women, while full-length pants and shirts for men. Traditional cloths work best in this case. Avoid sleeveless tops and shorts.
Q7. Is Ganga Aarti in Varanasi worth seeing?

Ans. Yes, the Ganga Aarti held at the Ghats of Varanasi is one of the most divine experiences you can have in the country. Watch the gazillion of lamps as they float by while the atmosphere is reverberated with divine chants and music!
Q8. What is special about Varanasi?

Ans. Varanasi is mainly popular for its ancient temples. Also, the Ganga Aarti rituals are its USP! Overall, it's the spiritual aura of the place that draws so many devotees here throughout the year. Plus, people love it for it's a hub for yoga and Ayurveda as well.
Q9. Is Varanasi safe for senior citizens?

Ans. Yes, Varanasi is quite safe for senior citizens, especially if you visit the popular places like Dashashwamedh Ghat and Assi Ghat, which are always bustling with tourists. However, we advise that you don't stay out late at night. Also, in crowded areas, be wary of pickpockets.
Q10. Which is better taking a train or flight from Delhi to Varanasi?

Ans. Both modes of transport have their own advantages. If you travel by flight, then it will take under two hours to reach there. If you're travelling with elderly people, air travel is the best option. Trains, on the other hand, will save you money and are ideal for pilgrims who are on a budget.
